verdict.rationale: Carta publishes developer API docs, so agent-readable docs are a fair question to ask, but the probes found no agent-oriented docs. llms.txt returns 404, markdown docs return 404, and every candidate OpenAPI spec path returns 404. The Claude MCP plugin guide covers a different capability (an MCP server) and is not llms.txt or agent-consumable documentation, so it earns no credit here.
